**Finding: Compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

The Agreement imposes no employee non-solicitation or no-hire obligation on Mortgage Logic.com. I checked both planner-flagged sections (§ 8 Client covenants and § 10 confidentiality) and ran document-wide searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel"; the only hits were unrelated — the § 7 unsolicited commercial e-mail restriction, indemnity boilerplate listing officers/employees, and the § 8(c) covenant to limit Interface access to approved personnel.

That puts us at the playbook's preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so there is nothing to narrow on duration, scope or carve-outs.

One item to track outside this review: § 8(d) makes the Credit Data license "subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement." That separate instrument is not part of this document — worth confirming it contains no personnel non-solicit or no-hire restraint on us.
